content.v: 近日西班牙知名创作者El Rubius受邀前往R星North总部，观看开发总监Rob Nelson操作的近三小时《GTA6》闭门实机演示，本人并未上手游玩，随后他分享大量未公开的游戏机制与世界细节，Reddit社区进一步整理汇总。本作将于11月19日登陆 PS5、XSX|S平台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788734619_612100.jpg
技术与世界表现
演示版本运行在普通PS5主机，锁定30帧，本作暂无第一人称视角。El Rubius推测受主机CPU瓶颈限制，标准版PS5很难实现60帧，PS5 Pro也不保证解锁60帧高帧率模式。
游戏实现室内‑室外无缝过渡，进入完整可交互酒店，搭乘电梯直达屋顶全程没有加载画面。登上屋顶之后可以直接夺取屋顶停放的直升机。
世界细节丰富：沙滩会留下脚印，海滩人群会随时间动态更迭。冲撞NPC可能撞飞对方手机、眼镜等随身物件。和狗狗互动需要先征得主人许可，主人与狗狗都可以拒绝玩家的抚摸行为。
游戏中存在特殊随机事件，玩家可能会在街上遇到裸体NPC，其所有部位都露在外面以逼真方式摆动。触发护送对方回家的支线，任务会给予丰厚奖励。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788734619_917629.jpg
抢劫任务系统升级
抢劫玩法不再局限主线剧情，玩家可以自由独立抢劫珠宝店等商铺。3D地图会直接标记目标店铺战利品预估价值区间（珠宝店约15000‑40000美元），同时标注可利用的入口点位，方便玩家提前制定作案计划。
保险箱密码可以通过搜索办公桌、环境线索获取；金条、钻石、现金都需要玩家手动逐个拾取；即便是抢劫加油站收银台，钱财也不会一键获取，必须一件件拿取。抢劫过程中，另一名主角会 AI 自主行动，控制现场人员，不需要玩家手动操控。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260831/1788184037_263843_jpg_r.jpg
车辆全新交互机制
1、后备箱可以藏匿尸体，杰森与露西亚两名主角也可以躲进后备箱藏身。
2、行驶途中能够打开副驾车门，利用车门撞击路人、其他载具，可以将摩托骑手直接撞下车。
3、系列首次加入电动滑板车，骑行状态下支持踢击动作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260831/1788184037_175279_jpg_r.jpg
双主角动态关系
两位主角的伙伴关系存在动态变化。演示片段出现抢劫完成后，露西亚直接抛下杰森独自脱身的情节，杰森会发送消息对此进行指责。这类分歧事件会影响后续合作抢劫任务当中两人的配合效果，主角间互动会实实在在反馈到游戏玩法层面。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《巫师4》进入全面制作阶段 CDPR暂不公布具体开发节点
items.summary: 近日在CDPR2026上半年财报投资者问答会上，联合CEO米哈乌・诺瓦科夫斯基回应投资者对于《巫师4》开发进度的问询。本作定位为CDPR迄今为止规模最大、野心最高的开放世界RPG，目标是2028年发售，但尚未锁定确切上市

content.v: 近日在CDPR2026上半年财报投资者问答会上，联合CEO米哈乌・诺瓦科夫斯基回应投资者对于《巫师4》开发进度的问询。本作定位为CDPR迄今为止规模最大、野心最高的开放世界RPG，目标是2028年发售，但尚未锁定确切上市日期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788734014_857288_jpg_r.jpg
诺瓦科夫斯基确认《巫师4》进入全面制作阶段。团队已经敲定游戏整体方向、核心玩法与内容框架，现阶段主要工作为填充游戏内容。项目内部设有大量开发节点与里程碑，不过绝大多数都属于技术层面的内部校验标准，对外界玩家与投资者参考意义有限，官方不会对外披露每一个具体节点进度。
诺瓦科夫斯基说：“我们很清楚自己正在打造一款怎样的作品。内部会检查每个批次、每个里程碑，评估开发进度、排查阻碍、判断是否需要迭代打磨，但不会对外公开这些细节，我们会把重心放在踏踏实实完成游戏开发直到发售。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788734014_214585_jpg_r.jpg
CDPR官方坦言《巫师4》各个模块开发进度并不均衡：部分支线任务、文案编写推进快于预期；而战斗系统还需要大量打磨与bug修复工作。大型项目很难用单一的Alpha、Beta节点概括整体进度，还要兼顾多平台性能优化等大量技术工作。参考历史，《巫师3》当年也曾经历两次延期，因此2028仅为目标窗口，仍存在变动可能性。
官方还提到内部开发流程吸取了《赛博朋克2077》教训，设立严格跨平台技术校验，如果某一平台版本达不到阶段标准，对应开发里程碑就不能继续推进，避免问题堆积到开发末期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 太空 歌剧RPG《大迁离》(Exodus)将于2027年4月7日登陆PC、PS5和XSX|S。近日外媒IGN采访制作组，团队详解抉择后果、同伴恋爱、时间膨胀、世界观设定，同时回应外界将本作视作《质量效应》精神续作的评价。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788733862_472723_jpg_r.jpg
《大迁离》拥有“圣骑‑不朽”双轴道德体系，不等同简单的善恶二选一。主角Jun拥有基因异变，可与远古“辰族”科技交互。圣骑路线坚守人性，警惕辰族力量带来的异化。而不朽路线拥抱辰族力量换取生存与实力，但会变得更加冷酷无情。你的各项选择会推动角色偏向其中一方。
开发组将抉择划分为三个层级：即时对话小选择、影响同伴好感的中层抉择、改写故事走向的“断点”重大抉择。主角拥有类似心理预测模型的能力，可以预览重大决定带来的潜在后果，该能力会随剧情不断变强。制作组强调选择必须付出代价，部分结局与内容会被单次流程锁死，一周目无法体验全部内容。游戏刻意让玩家陷入两难，承担抉择带来的心理负担。
同伴系统方面，所有队友拥有独立诉求与立场，同伴之间也会互相冲突。你的抉择会改变好感度，部分队友可能在流程中途离队，通关时未必能保留全部开局队友。恋爱路线不锁性别，但必须由玩家主动发起，不会被动触发恋情；可以尝试同时追求多名角色，但会产生现实向的复杂后果。恋爱仅影响人物剧情走向，不会提供战斗数值加成。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788733862_297773_jpg_r.jpg
亲密场景表现尺度偏向克制，接近原版《质量效应》风格，不会走露骨路线。人气章鱼机甲角色Salt无法攻略，角色设定本身就觉得人类形态怪异。主角无论选择男性/女性，不会改变NPC的基础反应，NPC态度主要由玩家的行为抉择决定。
“时间膨胀”是本作核心 科幻 叙事机制：进行星际远航时，主角体感只度过短短数日，但母星会流逝数年乃至数十年。远航前玩家需要布局“旅者王朝”势力，托付亲信维系后方秩序。当你结束远征归来，世界和亲友都已发生巨大改变，你必须承担时间错位造成的一切后果。但并非所有任务都会触发时间膨胀，只有跨恒星系远征才会产生该效果。
世界观围绕“旅者王朝”政治势力展开，主角出身强大的阿斯拉王朝，父亲失踪、同父异母的手足夺权迫使主角流亡，主线包含夺回家族权柄、与其他王朝缔结同盟的政治博弈。故事两大核心主题是演化与牺牲，探讨物种的蜕变进化，以及星际旅人为守护家园所要付出的沉重代价——你奋力想要守护的事物，归来时或许早已不复存在。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788733862_565415_jpg_r.jpg
面对大量玩家拿本作和《质量效应》做对比，叙事总监Drew Karpyshyn表示并不反感。他称希望本作能继承老作品的精神内核，同时做出全新体验。如果未来《大迁离》能和自己过往作品被玩家并列看待，会是莫大的认可。他也评价当下RPG行业佳作频出，行业标准持续抬升，团队希望在此基础之上做出有新意的故事体验。

items.title: 前索尼高管谈实体光盘消亡：令人沮丧但有解决办法
items.summary: 近日前SIE全球工作室总裁肖恩・莱登(Shawn Layden)接受采访，针对PlayStation即将走向无实体光盘的未来发表看法。他认为该局面令人沮丧，但并非无法解决。此前有媒体误读奥地利工厂消息，称索尼光盘产量将暴

content.v: 近日前SIE全球工作室总裁肖恩・莱登(Shawn Layden)接受采访，针对PlayStation即将走向无实体光盘的未来发表看法。他认为该局面令人沮丧，但并非无法解决。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788733240_424786_jpg_r.jpg
此前有媒体误读奥地利工厂消息，称索尼光盘产量将暴跌至原有10%。索尼DADC官方后续澄清，实际是整体产量下降10%，并非产能压缩至原来的一成。2028年之后，2028年1月前发售的老游戏光盘依旧支持重印补货，只是不再为全新游戏压制实体碟片。
目前PlayStation光盘压制工艺完全掌握在索尼自家手中，一旦索尼正式停止生产，第三方厂商没有权限自行制作PS游戏光盘。莱登提出解决方案：索尼可以效仿微软模式，将光盘生产授权给第三方合规压盘工厂，以此延续实体版的可能性。微软当下正是通过授权“授权复制厂商”，交由外部工厂生产Xbox实体光盘。
莱登强调实体介质对于核心玩家具备不可替代的价值，收藏本身就是游戏文化体验的一部分。他说：“市场已经用实际购买行为证明，依旧有玩家愿意购买实体版。现在只是索尼自己不想继续生产而已。”
CDPR联合CEO此前也表态，就算索尼不再提供光盘压制渠道，《巫师4》依旧计划推出实体版本，但该设想能否落地，取决于能否拿到PS光盘生产授权。莱登也承认这终究是企业层面商业抉择，如果索尼不开放授权，第三方厂商就没有办法自主推出PS游戏实体光盘。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 近日终极非对称 恐怖 沙盒游戏《月光光心慌慌》(Halloween:The Game)新实机演示公布，展示了游戏画面和玩法。本作将于9月8日登陆PS5、XSX|S和PC，豪华版预购玩家可提前4天进入游戏。
实机演示：
新实机片段引发玩家热烈讨论。部分玩家针对QTE、击杀演出、角色动作提出吐槽，也有不少玩家担忧开发商后续运营，出现“开发组多久会卷钱跑路”这类调侃评论。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788733029_560881_jpg_r.jpg

《月光光心慌慌》游戏改编自1978年经典恐怖电影，故事发生在万圣节夜晚的哈登菲尔德小镇，采用1对4非对称沙盒对抗玩法。玩家一方扮演杀人魔迈克尔・迈尔斯，依靠暗影位移“形态跳跃”技能隐匿身形、在黑夜当中狩猎居民。其余最多四名玩家扮演小镇幸存者，需要拯救AI平民、搜集物资、呼叫警方支援，利用环境道具自卫求生。本作的一大特色是地图内拥有大量具备独立行为逻辑的普通NPC，居民见到凶手会报警、反抗，让整个小镇拥有鲜活的临场感。
除多人对抗模式之外，本作还加入系列同类型作品少见的单人剧情战役，以迈克尔・迈尔斯的视角重新演绎原作电影当晚的故事，单人模式解锁的外观奖励还可以继承到多人模式使用。虚幻5引擎完整还原哈登菲尔德街区、迈尔斯老宅等经典场景，灯光电路均可人为破坏，迈克尔能够切断电源制造停电，借助黑暗展开狩猎。迈克尔本身无法被彻底击杀，幸存者目标以完成对局目标为主，和传统非对称恐怖游戏的胜负逻辑有所区别。

items.title: 一位爱好开发者为《战锤 40K》构建了免费的 3D 星系地图，在浏览器中加载起来就像闪电一样
items.summary: I just think it's neat.

content.v: Sometimes it's nice to just find something cool and fun and free on the internet, and the Cartographia Imperialis is just that: A 3D galaxy map of the Warhammer 40K Milky Way you can peruse in your browser.

It has the same simple, awe-inspiring majesty as Mass Effect's take on the concept, and you can explore it like an isometric videogame: Left click and drag to pan around, right click to rotate the camera, mouse wheel to zoom in and out. You can click on notable planets or regions to get little lore entries, or pull 'em up by name in the index to snap straight there on the map.

I'm not sure where creator Sami Gashi sourced the text for entries, pulling straight from official sources or paraphrasing in their own words, but I quite like the very in-universe prose. Take the entry for largely-unremarkable hive world Jouran, for example: "Its dossier is a reminder that strategic maps hide ordinary misery behind a clean point of light," the entry reads. "Jouran's value lies in quotas met, bodies counted, and local authorities willing to preserve output by any sanctioned means." That's good stuff.

Perhaps best of all, Cartographia Imperialis is completely free with no ads, and the map is shockingly lightweight for its graphical presentation and the current state of the internet. It loads super quick, and I haven't experienced any slowdown clicking around.

The only thing I'm missing is a nod to the Koronus Expanse of Rogue Trader fame, my personal gateway drug into the 40K universe . But that feels like a peevish, small-minded complaint given how cool and freely-given this thing is. Creator Gashi has a Ko-Fi page set up if you would like to support them⁠—they indicate an interest in creating interactive maps for other fictional worlds as well, and I'd love to see their take on other settings.

If you're looking for other, similarly impressive and open-hearted delights on the modern internet, I would point you away from the dark future of the 41st millennium and towards the links. Putt.day is low-key one of our favorite games of 2026 here at PC Gamer. It's a free, browser-based minigolf game that plays like proto-friendslop favorite, Golf With Your Friends , and it's updated with a new, community-sourced hole every day like minigolf Wordle .

items.title: 由于AI计算需求太旺 Xbox云游戏正在亏损
items.summary: 最近Xbox公布了云游戏策略一项重大调整。现在，玩家可以使用的游戏时间将受到限制，Game Pass Ultimate用户的上限为15小时。这听起来很荒谬，但现在我们终于知道原因了。据外媒Windows Central报

content.v: 最近Xbox公布了云游戏策略一项重大调整。现在，玩家可以使用的游戏时间将受到限制，Game Pass Ultimate用户的上限为15小时。这听起来很荒谬，但现在我们终于知道原因了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260907/1788732123_961237_jpg_r.jpg
据外媒Windows Central报道，人工智能（AI）的计算需求导致Xbox云游戏业务亏损。因此，超过15小时后，该公司将面临亏损。这也是他们推出超过15小时后需付费的原因。
云游戏虽然还不是最流行的游戏方式，但对于那些没有电脑或买不起昂贵硬件的人来说，无疑非常方便，尤其是在当前人工智能驱动的、价格虚高的市场环境下。
然而，这项新的服务时间限制可能会让那些想要体验这项服务的用户望而却步，甚至可能赶走一些现有用户;但是，在当前市场环境下，由于计算需求旺盛，这项限制似乎又是必要的。

content.v: It already felt weird and wonderful to say that PC Gamer has reviewed Metal Gear Solid 4 , a game for the personal computer. Now it gets even weirder: MGS4 mods are incoming, with TriggerHappy on YouTube already showing off a custom map in Kojima's 2008 stealth-action classic.

Back in 2021, modder Jayveer showed off a map ported from Metal Gear Arcade into Metal Gear Online 2 , the multiplayer accompaniment to MGS4, but to my knowledge, TriggerHappy's is the first demonstration of a custom singleplayer map in MGS4.

It's 55 beautiful seconds of Old Snake crouch walking around Groznyj Grad, the iconic fortress level of Metal Gear Solid 3. Only now it's infested with Gecko walkers mooing their incongruous moos and showing off their distractingly shapely legs. Stupid, sexy Geckos. TriggerHappy laconically describes the gameplay as "initial testing for adding AI to a custom map."

The enemy AI certainly seems to work: Those Geckos are not happy to see Snake, and it's not because they believe a man of his age shouldn't be putting so much stress on his back and knees. It's unclear how TriggerHappy got this custom map working, or how far away we are from widely available map making tools, but this is an exciting first step in the realm of custom content for MGS4.

I've mostly connected Master Collection modding with the essential performance and visual fixes that the community needed to cook up after Volume One's disastrous initial launch. Thankfully, not only has the Volume One situation vastly improved with official patches, but Konami shipped Volume Two (containing MGS4 and Peace Walker) in a much more acceptable condition.

Looking at the MGS4 Nexus , the projects on offer are fairly simple: Custom textures, miscellaneous tweaks, and an FPS unlocker all stood out to me. You can get DLSS5 working in there too, if you're into that sort of thing. Metal Gear is not a series I've ever strongly associated with modding, but I'm excited to see where we might go from here.

content.v: On September 5, Rebel Wolves took to Twitter on the official Blood of Dawnwalker account to announce that the dark vampire RPG had already surpassed one million copies sold just three days after its September 2 launch. "Thank you for playing, sharing, supporting, and being part of the community," the developer wrote in its celebratory post .

I was in a Star Wars Zero Company-shaped hole during Dawnwalker's contemporaneous review period, but everyone on our team who played has been pretty pleased with this very Witcher-like RPG from ex-Witcher devs. Australian editor Shaun Prescott awarded it an 83% in his review , praising the storytelling and combat, but wishing that Rebel Wolves had gone harder on Dawnwalker's unique time mechanics.

"Blood of Dawnwalker is an effective piece of worldbuilding and storytelling then, but it doesn't make good on its promise as an innovative piece of RPG design," Shaun wrote. "Maybe Rebel Wolves worried that too many players would fall afoul of the passage of time and thus loosened its severity."

He was even more on the money than he could have realized when he wrote that: Some of the first mods for Dawnwalker do away with the time limit entirely . I appreciate the "have it your way" ethos mods can have, but I think a bit of friction can be a very good thing. I unilaterally declare PC Gamer to be a pro-time limits publication.

Zooming out, it's exciting to see both Dawnwalker and Zero Company get rave reviews and strong sales during this challenging time for the industry. Disney hasn't announced any numbers for Zero Company, but it's sitting at a beefy 15,562 reviews and "Very Positive" on Steam a week and a half after launch, a compelling indicator that it's doing well. The similarly multi-platform Blood of Dawnwalker, by comparison, is at 8,296 total reviews after having passed the million mark in total sales.

Of course, Zero Company's success has a tinge of uncertainty to it that Rebel Wolves has been spared: 80% of developer Bit Reactor's staff is reportedly on furlough , awaiting sales revenue and further investment to secure their jobs.

items.summary: Halloween: The Game developer IllFonic has patched out a sex mini-game after a gameplay clip went viral. Now,

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/06/lynda-main-1788722523549.jpg
UPDATE: IllFonic has provided IGN with the following statement, confirming the removal of the sex minigame:

"Players may have noticed that our latest hotfix removed the Two-Person Power-Up minigame. This was due to an unintended issue that allowed end game reinforcement characters to engage with the minigame, which was a major oversight on our part. We have more content and minigames coming in the near future but current focus is our attention on immediate game needs. Keep an eye on our socials for updates as they become available.”
ORIGINAL STORY: Halloween: The Game developer IllFonic appears to have patched out a sex minigame after a gameplay clip went viral.

The video game adaptation of the iconic 1970s slasher movie lets players have sex in a closet, but one video of this minigame featuring Samuel Loomis raised eyebrows given the character, who is in his fifties during the events of the game and is based on deceased actor Donald Pleasence’s likeness, can have sex with teenagers.

Halloween: The Game doesn’t actually launch fully until September 8, but those who bought the Halloween Deluxe Edition were able to play from this weekend, and it didn’t take long for players to notice the sex minigame.

The game includes a number of playable characters made famous by the Halloween films. Bob Simms (voiced by Nicholas Leung), Annie Brackett (voiced by Kaitlyn Robrock), Lynda van der Klok (voiced by Angela Carbone), and Laurie Strode (voiced by Chelsea Krause) are all playable civilians across single-player and multiplayer.

The character of Samuel Loomis is the main protagonist of the Halloween movies and is a “hero civilian” in the game. Loomis is the psychiatrist of series antagonist Michael Myers, and tries to prevent his patient from his murderous rampage.

In the game two players can hide in a closet. If you hide in a closet with another player already inside, you get a prompt to ask them out. If you do this and the offer is accepted, you get a button mashing minigame to raise a line on a bar as the camera shakes and the characters grunt. If both players keep the line in the right part of the bar for long enough, they'll fill up a heart and both characters get the “Stronger Together” buff. You don’t actually see the characters do anything.
LOOMIS FUCKIN LYNDA IN THE CLOSET? pic.twitter.com/NKYAyF6GYU

The video that went viral shows Loomis entering a closet in which 17-year-old Lynda is already hiding, then completing the sex minigame. You can imagine the Pleasance estate — if it wasn’t aware of the use of the actor’s likeness in this way before it probably is now — taking a dim view of the gameplay.

IllFonic has yet to comment (IGN has asked), but it released a hotfix this weekend hot on the heels of the game’s early access launch. The removal of the sex minigame is not mentioned in the patch notes. Here’s what IllFonic said:

While IllFonic has yet to confirm the sex minigame's removal, Halloween: The Game players are now calling for it to be restored, perhaps with Samuel Loomis specifically prevented from taking part (if his inclusion is indeed the problem here). "Why did they remove it!??!?!?!?" asked redditor freetheree . "Me and my homeboy just wanna have sex in a closet? And we can’t???? Tf??????"
Some players now think they've missed out on what may go down as an early access exclusive sex minigame in Halloween: The Game.

items.title: Sabre Interactive 高管承诺：“《星际战士 3》中绝对没有生成式人工智能”
items.summary: The Machine Spirits lie silent.

content.v: In a Gamescom interview with IGN , Saber CCO and former id Software dev Tim Willits said that the company's upcoming Space Marine follow-up is not using generative AI in its development. The studio has otherwise been embracing the technology, which was at the heart of the recent Rideshare Stimulator controversy .

"There is absolutely no generative AI in Space Marine 3 or Hellraiser or Stuntman or Turok or Jurassic Park, or [ Saber's John Wick game ]," Willits told IGN. "But like we said, we're going to experiment with it. Try it out in Rideshare, see if it works. See if people like it. If they don't like it, we're like, 'All right.'"
It seems that Saber is far more circumspect about using generative AI in its big ticket games, especially when there are license holders like Lionsgate or Paramount to consider.

Warhammer 40K owner Games Workshop, for its part, is enforcing strict internal rules against genAI use in any of its products or advertising, a crowd-pleasing stance that contrasts with rival tabletop giant Wizards of the Coast's willingness to play footsie with AI usage.

But Willits, like Saber CEO Matt Karch, is solidly pro-AI, and sees smaller projects like Rideshare Stimulator as an opportunity to feel it out. "If you're going to experiment, it's a good one to experiment on," Willits said. "If anyone tells you that they have it figured out, they don't. It'll take a couple years and things will settle out and we'll figure it out."

PCG news writer Joshua Wolens had his own conversation with Willits at Gamescom, and touched on similar topics. Willits believes that team size and overspecialization are major contributing factors to the industry's current economic crisis, but also argues that this crisis isn't as bad as it's being presented . Willits also said that, had the OG id Software crew gotten their hands on generative AI back in the day, they would have aggressively used it.

items.title: Sabre 首席商务官 Tim Willits 仍然看好人工智能，但担心其对环境的影响：“埃隆希望将服务器放入太空。这可能就是答案，对吧？
items.summary: "I mean, it's funny, but why not?"

content.v: AI in gamedev is about as hot as hot topics get—the tech is polarizing for all sorts of reasons, not the least of which is its environmental impact. The data centers AI relies on come with grave heat and water use concerns at a time when our species' ecological footprint is already leaning toward the catastrophic . Developers like Saber Interactive are still experimenting with the technology to make videogames, though CCO Tim Willits acknowledged the concerns to PC Gamer's Joshua Wolens at Gamescom 2026.

"Personally, you know, whenever I look something up that maybe my wife asked for, I'm like, 'oh man, I'm destroying the environment to answer this question,'" Willits said. "So yes, that is a real issue. I mean, as a society. Globally. Look at the disasters happening even this week. So yes, mankind, we need to figure that out."

As for how mankind might do that, Willits cited a suggestion from right-wing billionaire, Tesla CEO and Path of Exile 2 n00b Elon Musk: "Elon wants to put servers in space . That could be the answer, right? I mean, it's funny, but why not? Starlink is fast. I don't care if I have to wait a couple of extra seconds to get my silly AI picture. But it is a problem, I think."

Recently, Saber has caught flak for its use of AI in the upcoming Rideshare Stimulator—one former writer for the studio alleged she was replaced with ChatGPT during development . While Saber denied that specific claim, it stood by its decision to use AI for dialog (which was, at that point, undisclosed on the game's Steam page), saying "we are firm believers in using AI tools to improve or enhance gameplay experiences."

AI isn't the only hot topic Willits is tuned in to. He also spoke with us about the 'silo problem' facing huge triple-A studios , as well as that recent Rideshare Stimulator controversy —and despite it all, he believes it's a "great time" to be in the games industry.

items.title: 您在日常生活中听过电子游戏音乐吗？
items.summary: Or should videogame music stay *inside* the game?

content.v: You know, I do a lot of prattling about videogame music at this humble website PC Gamer dot com. It's practically woven into the fabric of my very being at this point—hugely formative for me growing up, and now I carry little bits of it everywhere.

I have half a dozen VGM playlists dedicated to stuff like the gym, relaxing, and locking in at work. I've formed lifelong memories with friends as we've filled karaoke rooms with the sound of all kinds of Final Fantasy 14 tracks, where our so-called tastes in "regular" music might misalign; we're instead united by our mutual love and attachment to the songs we hear in a game.

In fact, it's so deeply entrenched into my everyday life that I can't imagine any videogame fan not listening to their favourite tunes outside of the game they came from. That is, until I was recently chatting with a friend where they told me just that: even if they really like a song in a videogame, they'll never go out of their way to listen to it detached from its origin.

So that had me wondering—how many of you actually listen to videogame music in your day-to-day life? Does it accompany you while you run errands? Do you have a playlist specifically dedicated to certain tasks or moods filled with songs from all of your favourite games? Or do you just get those random urges to listen to a videogame track that won't leave your head, leaving your YouTube or Spotify history littered with gaming-related earworms?

I'm interested to hear just how much you integrate videogame music into your day-to-day life, so be sure to drop a comment and let me know if you actually listen to any of it. And if you do, when or why are you doing it? I need to feel seen by my fellow sickos, please and thank you.

content.v: Like a lot of survival games, Stalker 2 had a long journey from janky larva to playable, easily recommended butterfly. It's tempting to say that these games ought to just stay under wraps until they're done and relatively bug-free—but at Gamescom 2026, GSC Game World CEO and head of game direction Ievgen Grygorovych told PC Gamer's Joshua Wolens that deciding when to release is a more complex consideration than you might think.

As for why the studio didn't just wait to release the game until it was in the state it is now, Grygorovych cited both creative and financial reasons. "To make something better, you need to receive feedback, and this feedback should be fresh. From a business perspective, it's also impossible, because it's very expensive to do two years of additional work … in most cases, it's unrealistic."

GSC Game World has more legitimate reasons than most to release an unfinished game. The Ukrainian studio was working on Stalker 2 when development was interrupted by Russia's invasion , forcing the team to move out of Kyiv, and its progress was later hamstrung by a devastating office fire and numerous leaks . And notably, the game's buggy release did arrive after delays —but regardless of all the unique trouble GSC Game World encountered, Grygorovych pointed to woeful market conditions across the board as another consideration.

"You have to always find the trade-offs that allow you to bring the best experience you can with what you have," he said. "It's always a balance because every developer would like to have an infinite amount of time, but the market around is awful: lots of layoffs, studios are closing. So actually, the market state is not very promising. We're just trying to find the best configuration we can."

items.title: 万圣节游戏中有一个性爱小游戏，但没有，因为它显然被删除了
items.summary: Some perverse pairings may be the culprit.

content.v: If you've seen any slasher flick, you know the drill: every youth is horny, and the horny must die. Despite Halloween not being quite as trope-riddled as some of its stabbiest contemporaries, its recent asymmetrical PvP adaptation did include a minigame where two players could slip into a closet and bang each other for buffs—but after only a few days in a deluxe edition-exclusive early access, the feature has reportedly been removed.

In fact, it seems to have been silently hotfixed out. The most recent patch notes make no mention of the sex minigame, but the comments sure do. On the Steam thread, one user commented "ADD BACK THE CLOSET MINIGAME" five times in a row. Others have noted that Lynda, a flirty playable civilian who previously got extra benefits from the sex minigame, has had that trait removed, which I can confirm with a quick launch of the game.

Players on social media are not pleased, as you might imagine. "Lame as hell," wrote Choice-Scholar-2297 on Reddit. A thread on the game's subreddit titled "Please add back sex mini game" is quickly gaining traction; freetheree's original post reads, "Why did they remove it!??!?!?!? Me and my homeboy just wanna have sex in a closet? And we can’t???? Tf??????"

Lots of the sorts of jokes you might expect are being thrown around, and of course, it is hilarious that if this change sticks the game will have had closet sex as an exclusive time-limited pre-order bonus. Unfortunately, there might be a good reason for its removal.

You see, players are also speculating about the reason this might have been changed: dead players can respawn as older characters, such as a police officer or Michael Myers' therapist Dr. Loomis. Fine on its own, disturbing when those characters can potentially solicit sex from a high schooler—Laurie Strode, for instance, is only 17 years old in the version this game depicts. While Illfonic has not confirmed this is why the feature was patched out, I struggle to imagine a more convincing reason.
I've reached out to Illfonic for comment on the patch, and this story will be updated if I hear back.
